applicationPercentiles.skewnessCommentary: Positive Right-Skew (+0.4): Arithmetic mean (42.2) is artificially elevated by power users. The median (9.5) represents typical user volume.

invariants.name: User Partition Integrity
invariants.description: Every registered account must be cleanly partitioned into either activated or dormant with zero overlaps or omissions.

invariants.name: Transactional Record Consistency
invariants.description: The sample size analyzed in the distribution percentiles must match the exact row count in the database collection.

invariants.name: Blast Radius Upper Bound
invariants.description: The count of users experiencing Sentry exceptions cannot exceed the total pool of active users in the window.

invariants.name: Percentile Rank Monotonicity
invariants.description: Cumulative distribution ranks must be monotonically non-decreasing.

invariants.name: Cohort Funnel Monotonicity
invariants.description: Standard conversion funnel volume must never increase at downstream stages.

invariants.name: Telemetry Capture Ceiling
invariants.description: Client telemetry matches must not exceed the authoritative transactional truth of the database.

userDistribution.definition: Classification of registered users into activated and dormant cohorts.
userDistribution.formula: Activated = {u in Users | count(Applications, userId = u.id) >= 1}; Dormant = Total - Activated
userDistribution.caveat: Guest sessions without an email or Firebase Auth UID are categorized as guest users and excluded from persistent registration counts.

applicationPercentiles.definition: Cumulative distribution percentiles of application volume per activated user.
applicationPercentiles.formula: Rank p: R7 method = (N - 1) * p; Skewness = (Mean - Median) / StdDev
applicationPercentiles.caveat: Arithmetic mean is distorted upward by high-frequency power users. Median (p50) represents authentic central tendency.

cohortFunnel.definition: End-to-end journey from initial landing session to first logged job application.
cohortFunnel.caveat: Time-to-first-application is measured from the user.createdAt timestamp to the earliest application.createdAt timestamp.

reliabilityImpact.definition: Impact of unhandled Sentry exceptions on active users and session abandonment.
reliabilityImpact.formula: AbandonmentRate = (Sessions hitting error that exited without next action / Total sessions hitting error) * 100
reliabilityImpact.caveat: Requires Sentry tags to include posthog_session_id (configured in src/lib/posthog.ts).

reconciliationAudit.definition: Reconciliation of client-reported application creations against database records.
reconciliationAudit.caveat: Discrepancy is primarily attributed to privacy extensions / ad-blockers (uBlock Origin, Brave Shields) blocking posthog-js.
